game.cinema.long: Who stars in Titanic? Who directed Jurassic Park? Which film features Jack Sparrow? Questions about great films, from Hollywood to Moroccan cinema.

q.cinema.year: What year did this film come out?

game.maroc.long: Morocco as we love it: cities, food, crafts, history, Darija expressions and great sites.
game.hello.long: “Shukran”, “Arigatō”, “Asante”… Thank you and goodbye in 18 languages, including Amazigh.
game.space.long: The planets, the Moon, the stars and the great space missions.
game.body.long: The heart, the brain, bones and senses: everything that keeps our body going.
game.dinos.long: Triceratops, T. rex, Morocco’s Spinosaurus… All about dinosaurs and their time.
game.vocab.long: 64 everyday words with emojis: fruit, animals, home, colours… Translate them into French (or into English for other languages).
game.roadsigns.long: The most common road signs and basic rules, to revise for a driving licence in Morocco.
game.sport.long: Football, tennis, rugby, basketball, Olympics, F1 and cycling: a mix of every discipline.
game.football.long: World Cup, AFCON, the Atlas Lions, great clubs and football legends.
game.tennis.long: Roland-Garros, Wimbledon, rules and great champions.
game.rugby.long: Scoring, rules, the All Blacks, the Springboks and the World Cup.
game.basketball.long: The rules, the NBA, the Dream Team and the big stars.
game.olympics.long: The Olympics, world records and Moroccan champions, from El Guerrouj to El Moutawakel.
game.motorsport.long: Formula 1, the Tour de France, Le Mans 24 Hours and the Dakar Rally.
game.daily.long: Every day, 10 questions from different games, identical for everyone. One game per day: share your score as coloured squares without giving away the answers.
game.pin: Drop your pin on the map
game.pin.long: A capital is named: drop your pin where you think it is. The closer you are, the more points you get; the distance is shown in kilometres.
game.flagreveal: The flag is revealed bit by bit
game.flagreveal.long: Tiles hide the flag and fall away one by one. Answer as early as you can: in multiplayer, the fastest score the most.
game.higher.long: Two countries head to head: which has more people, or the larger area? The figures are shown with the answer.
game.chain: A country starting with the last letter
game.chain.long: A country is given: type another one that starts with its last letter, in your language (Morocco → Oman…). Every valid answer counts.
game.timezones: What time is it in Tokyo?
game.timezones.long: It is noon in Paris: what time is it in New York, Tokyo or Dubai? Offsets are today's, daylight saving included.
game.sounds.long: Real recordings of animals: listen and find who makes the sound. Free sounds from Wikimedia Commons, author shown with the answer.
game.tables.long: A times-tables race: every right answer moves your car forward. Easy: the 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10 tables; hard: up to 12 and the missing factor.
game.timeline.long: Four events to put from oldest to newest: the pyramids, the French Revolution, the Moon landing, Moroccan independence…
game.stadiums.long: Real photos of famous stadiums, courts and circuits: find their name, the club or tournament played there, or their country. Free photos from Wikimedia Commons.
game.kits.long: A kit drawn in a club's or national team's colours: stripes, hoops, a band… can you name the team?

game.prog_geo: Morocco and the world, from grade 1 to middle school
game.prog_geo.long: Questions inspired by the Moroccan curriculum: compass points, seas and mountains of Morocco, regions, climate, world landmarks. The level picks the grade: 1–3, 4–6 or middle school.
game.prog_hist.long: From the Idrisids to independence: dynasties, city foundations, national holidays and key dates, from grade 1 to middle school.
game.prog_sci: Living things, matter, the human body
game.prog_sci.long: States of water, animals, plants, the human body, electricity: science questions from grade 1 to middle school.
game.tifinagh: The Amazigh alphabet, letter by letter
game.tifinagh.long: Learn the 33 letters of the Tifinagh alphabet (IRCAM): their sound and name, then a few first words such as ⴰⵣⵓⵍ (azul, hello).
game.macities: Place the cities on the map
game.macities.long: Drop your pin on 40 Moroccan cities, from Tangier to Dakhla: the closer, the more points. Or find which region each city is in.

game.event.long: A special quiz for a few days: score at least 50 % on 5 questions or more to win the event badge.

look.title: Dress my avatar
game.peaks: Each country's highest peak, each capital's river
game.peaks.long: What is Peru's highest peak? Which river does Baghdad stand on? 95 questions drawn from Wikidata, Wikipedia's big free database.
game.records: The longest, the highest, the biggest…
game.records.long: Longest river, biggest lake, highest peak: guess the record, or pick the winner among four. Lengths, areas and heights from Wikidata.
game.inventions: Who invented what? Who discovered what?
game.inventions.long: From the printing press to the QR code, from penicillin to Jupiter's moons: 50 inventions and discoveries, plus the founder of the world's oldest university, in Fez. Inventors checked in Wikidata.
game.afrisport.long: Hakimi, El Guerrouj, Salah, Kipchoge, Ons Jabeur… Which country are they from? In which sport did they shine? 81 questions drawn from Wikidata.

game.memory: Find the flag and country pairs

duel.ttt.how: Pick a square: it has a theme. Answer right and your mark goes there; otherwise it stays free. Line up 3 to win.
duel.c4q.how: Pick a column, then answer: right, your counter drops; wrong, you miss your turn. Line up 4.
duel.c4.how: Drop your counters in turn. First to line up 4 wins.
duel.ships.how: Each side has 4 hidden ships on a 6 × 6 sea. Pick a target, answer right to fire. Hit: play again. Sink the whole fleet.
duel.hangman.how: A hidden country or capital. In turn, guess a letter (right: play again) or the whole word. 5 lives per round, 3 rounds.
duel.dots.how: Draw a line in turn. If you close a box, answer a question: right, it's yours and you play again; wrong, it stays grey.
duel.memory.how: Turn over two cards: a flag and its country name make a pair. Pair found: play again.
duel.caravan.how: Roll the die and race to the final oasis. ❓: a question, +2 if right. 🐪: +2. ⛰️: −2. 🌴: miss a turn.
duel.awale.how: Take all the seeds from one of your pits and sow them one by one. If your last seed lands on the other side making 2 or 3, you capture them. Over 24 seeds wins.
